title: Russian general Igor Kirillov killed by a scooter bomb in Moscow
body:
On 17 December 2024 Lieutenant General Igor Kirillov, aged 54, and his assistant were killed in a bomb blast in Moscow, according to Al Jazeera. Kirillov had been chief of Russia's Radiological, Chemical and Biological Defence Troops since April 2017. A bomb hidden in an electric scooter exploded outside an apartment building on Ryazansky Prospekt, about 7 kilometres southeast of the Kremlin. TASS reported that the device had roughly 300 grams of TNT equivalent, and Russian media said it was remotely operated. About 10 apartments were reportedly damaged.

A source in Ukraine's Security Service, the SBU, told Al Jazeera that the agency was responsible, though Ukraine did not officially comment. On 16 December the SBU had accused Kirillov of using banned chemical weapons in Ukraine, saying Russian forces had used banned chemical munitions more than 4,800 times. The United Kingdom and Canada had sanctioned Kirillov over the war.

Russia's Investigative Committee opened a criminal case and called the bombing a terrorist attack. Security Council deputy chairman Dmitry Medvedev blamed Ukraine for cowardly strikes on peaceful cities.
